messages.subject: Harborlight subscription — engagement
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

As discussed, we'd like Whitfield Carter to handle the SaaS subscription and data licence we're putting in front of Harborlight Retail Group. They're our largest prospective customer to date — enterprise tier, three-year term. Can you send through your engagement letter and a team?

Daniel Okonkwo will be your day-to-day contact on commercials; Sofia Trevino (our GC) on the legal terms.

Best,
Henry

messages.plaintextBody:
Henry,

Delighted to help. Our engagement letter is attached. I'll lead, with James Osei (senior associate) and Elena Marchetti (associate) supporting. We'll prepare the subscription agreement, SOW, SLA and DPA and run the negotiation with Harborlight's advisers.

Daniel/Sofia — once you've sent the heads of terms across we'll turn the first draft around quickly.

Kind regards,
Sarah Whitfield
